mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_report_order_ownership(order_id, merchant_id, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{merchantId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = CASE WHEN status = 'CONFLICT' OR #{status} = 'CONFLICT' OR merchant_id <> #{merchantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} THEN 'CONFLICT' ELSE #{status} END, merchant_id = COALESCE(merchant_id, #{merchantId,jdbcType=BIGINT})

INSERT INTO payment_report_order_ownership AS ownership (order_id, merchant_id, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{merchantId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{status}) ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO UPDATE SET status = CASE WHEN ownership.status = 'CONFLICT' OR EXCLUDED.status = 'CONFLICT' OR ownership.merchant_id <> EXCLUDED.merchant_id THEN 'CONFLICT' ELSE EXCLUDED.status END, merchant_id = COALESCE(ownership.merchant_id, EXCLUDED.merchant_id)
